name: return-await-array
source:
async function f(){const tasks=[1].map(async x=>x);return await tasks;}
[1].map(async x=>x);
reason: Await preserves an ordinary array; returning it transfers ownership.

name: return-await-inline
source:
async function f(){return await [1].map(async x=>x);}
[1].map(async x=>x);
reason: Same transfer in inline expression.

name: return-choice-array
source:
function f(flag){const tasks=[1].map(async x=>x);return flag?tasks:{tasks};}
[1].map(async x=>x);
reason: Both branches transfer promise array; cannot establish drop.

name: yield-array
source:
function* f(){const tasks=[1].map(async x=>x);yield tasks;}
[1].map(async x=>x);
reason: Generator yields ownership to caller.

name: spread-helper-consumption
source:
async function settle(...items){return Promise.all(items)}const tasks=[1].map(async x=>x);await settle(...tasks);
[1].map(async x=>x);
reason: Rest helper settles individual promises; spread is transfer.

name: spread-opaque-consumption
source:
const tasks=[1].map(async x=>x);consume(...tasks);
[1].map(async x=>x);
reason: Unknown consumer receives individual promises; abstain.

name: push-spread-consumption
source:
const tasks=[1].map(async x=>x);const pending=[];pending.push(...tasks);await Promise.all(pending);
[1].map(async x=>x);
reason: Array push transfers individual promises to settled array.

name: combiner-spread-arguments
source:
const tasks=[1].map(async x=>x);await Promise.all(...[tasks]);
[1].map(async x=>x);
reason: Argument spread passes tasks as first iterable.

name: return-void-array
source:
function f(){const tasks=[1].map(async x=>x);return void tasks;}
[1].map(async x=>x);
reason: Void discards array; ownership does not transfer.

name: return-length-array
source:
function f(){const tasks=[1].map(async x=>x);return tasks.length;}
[1].map(async x=>x);
reason: Returning length does not transfer promises.

name: await-array-only
source:
async function f(){const tasks=[1].map(async x=>x);await tasks;}
[1].map(async x=>x);
reason: Awaiting array without transfer drops elements.

name: helper-void-array
source:
function ignore(...items){return undefined}const tasks=[1].map(async x=>x);ignore(...tasks);
[1].map(async x=>x);
reason: Known helper discards elements.

name: fetch-prototype-signal
source:
const c=new AbortController();fetch("/",{__proto__:{signal:c.signal}});
fetch("/positive");
reason: Dictionary inherited property supplies signal.

name: fetch-prototype-null
source:
fetch("/",{__proto__:{signal:null}});
fetch("/positive");
reason: Inherited null lacks cancellation.

name: fetch-prototype-own-null
source:
const c=new AbortController();fetch("/",{__proto__:{signal:c.signal},signal:null});
fetch("/positive");
reason: Own null overrides inherited signal.

name: fetch-request-copy
source:
const c=new AbortController();const r=new Request("https://example.invalid",{signal:c.signal});fetch(new Request(r));
fetch("/positive");
reason: Request copy retains signal.

name: timer-return-await-cleanup
source:
import {useEffect} from "react";useEffect(()=>{const h=setTimeout(()=>{},1);return ()=>{clearTimeout(h)}},[]);
import {useEffect} from "react";useEffect(()=>{setTimeout(()=>{},1)},[]);
reason: Normal cleanup control.

name: timer-guarded-callback
source:
import {useEffect} from "react";useEffect(()=>{let alive=true;setTimeout(()=>{if(!alive)return;work()},1);return()=>{alive=false}},[]);
import {useEffect} from "react";useEffect(()=>{setTimeout(()=>{},1)},[]);
reason: Timer remains scheduled; wording must preserve cancellation guards.

name: timer-cleanup-call-parameter
source:
import {useEffect} from "react";function stop(h){clearTimeout(h)}useEffect(()=>{const h=setTimeout(()=>{},1);return()=>stop(h)},[]);
import {useEffect} from "react";useEffect(()=>{setTimeout(()=>{},1)},[]);
reason: Direct helper actually cancels handle.

name: timer-cleanup-factory
source:
import {useEffect} from "react";function makeCleanup(h){return()=>clearTimeout(h)}useEffect(()=>{const h=setTimeout(()=>{},1);return makeCleanup(h)},[]);
import {useEffect} from "react";useEffect(()=>{setTimeout(()=>{},1)},[]);
reason: Known documented unresolved factory; unnecessary review candidate.
